title: Sayonara, Phantoms
description: A mod/datapack that disables the spawning of Phantoms from your worlds!
body:
# Sayonara, Phantoms!

[Download from Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/sayonara-phantoms)

Phantoms are really annoying mobs, especially if you go AFK and come back to finding out you've been killed by them on the roof of your base (it happened to a friend).

Once you load a world, the embedded datapack will execute the `gamerule spawn_phantoms false` command to disable spawning of these mobs automatically.

# Installation

## Mod

This mod is provided as both a .jar file as a universal mod for the following loaders:
- Fabric
- Quilt
- Forge
- Neoforge

*For those on Fabric and Quilt: you may need the Fabric API mod to be installed so that the datapack can be properly loaded*

## Datapack

For those that want it as a datapack, just download the .zip file and add it to the `datapacks` folder on your save
